ahmedml.name: AhmedML
ahmedml.summary: High-fidelity, time-averaged data from transient hybrid RANS–LES simulations of 500 parametrically varied Ahmed bodies, with native three-dimensional boundary and volume fields, geometry, force coefficients, slices, images, and deterministic data-efficiency and out-of-distribution splits.

source.availability: 500 field-bearing cases; approximately 3.08 TB for the complete pinned repository
source.contents: STL geometry, native boundary VTP and volume VTU fields, force and geometry tables, CFD slices and images, eight split families, and one native polygon-area sidecar per boundary mesh.

image.alt: Mean streamwise-velocity slice through an AhmedML body and its wake.
image.caption: Mean streamwise-velocity slice from AhmedML run 1.

archetypes.name: Ahmed body
archetypes.description: A single simplified automotive bluff-body family; every case is a continuous variant of this parent geometry.

design_space.parameter_summary: The source varies the rear treatment and the main body dimensions while retaining the recognizable Ahmed-body topology.
design_space.operating_conditions: The operating setup is fixed across the dataset, so the intended breadth comes from geometry rather than a boundary-condition sweep.
design_space.sampling: Latin hypercube sampling fills the six-dimensional parameter box with 500 geometry cases.
design_space.coverage: The eight published source splits separate the random full-data task, nested data-efficiency tasks, and held-out geometry, force, and wake regimes. All eight candidate benchmark bindings now use the exact pinned public case IDs; the four nested data-efficiency splits share the same 50-case test set.

benchmark.summary: The owner-review candidate scores complete native boundary pMean and wallShearStressMean, complete native-volume UMean and pMean, reconstructed force coefficients, three 128-point surface Cp cuts, four 128-point wake-velocity profiles, and report-only near-body/wake/farfield diagnostics. Case IDs and source bytes are pinned, but public submissions remain closed pending owner approval.

visual.support: Native surface polygons and volume cells
visual.metrics: Area-weighted surface errors; equal-cell volume errors; forces and profiles

drivaerml.name: DrivAerML
drivaerml.summary: High-fidelity, time-averaged data from scale-resolving simulations of 500 designed DrivAer notchback variants. The public release currently provides 484 complete CFD cases, native surface and volume fields, geometry, forces, diagnostic images, and eight official split families.

source.availability: 484 complete public cases from 500 designs; approximately 31 TB
source.contents: STL geometry, native boundary VTP fields, multipart native volume VTUs, constant- and variable-reference force tables, slices, images, eight official splits, and one native polygon-area sidecar per public boundary mesh.

image.alt: DrivAerML car with a coloured Q-criterion wake showing streamwise velocity.
image.caption: Q-criterion wake coloured by streamwise velocity for DrivAerML run 1.

archetypes.name: Ford OCDA DrivAer notchback
archetypes.description: The AutoCFD reference configuration with static wheels, sealed cooling inlets, and a detailed underbody.

design_space.parameter_summary: ANSA morphing boxes introduce deliberately subtle, industry-like changes around one notchback parent while preserving component topology.
design_space.operating_conditions: All designs use the same open-road setup at 38.889 m/s and wheelbase Reynolds number 7.19 × 10⁶; Reynolds number and incoming-flow angle are not sampled.
design_space.sampling: A modified extensible lattice sequence distributes 500 designs through the 16-dimensional morphing space; 484 complete cases are public.
design_space.coverage: Eight official source split families cover random and nested-data tasks plus held-out geometry, force, and rear-separation regimes over the 484 public cases. FluidsBench scoring remains candidate rather than open.

benchmark.summary: The candidate contract binds all 484 public cases, eight official split lists, pMeanTrim and wallShearStressMeanTrim on every native surface polygon, UMeanTrim and pMeanTrim on every native volume cell, constant-reference force truth, AutoCFD5 velocity profiles, and continuous Cp cuts. Surface area sidecars, equal-cell volume accumulation, and all-case native profile truth are published; evaluator freezing, remaining diagnostic review, and genuine-model sensitivity analysis remain before public submissions can open.

visual.support: All native surface polygons and native volume cells
visual.metrics: Area-weighted surface errors; equal-cell volume errors; field-integrated forces and AutoCFD5 profiles

drivaernetplusplus.name: DrivAerNet++
drivaernetplusplus.summary: A large multimodal automotive-aerodynamics collection with 8,150 vehicle designs spanning fastback, notchback, and estateback categories, including surface and volume CFD, meshes, coefficients, annotations, point clouds, and rendered or sketched geometry representations.

source.release: Canonical index commit 8b8c053; pressure archive Dataverse v1.0
source.availability: 8,150 designs; approximately 39 TB across the complete multimodal collection
source.contents: Volume fields, surface pressure and wall-shear data, point clouds, meshes, aerodynamic coefficients, design annotations, and visual modalities. FluidsBench currently has a pressure-only candidate task tied to Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/K7PWNJ v1.0.

image.alt: Side and front views of a DrivAerNet++ vehicle showing its geometric design parameters.
image.caption: Representative DrivAerNet++ vehicle parameters and body views.

design_space.parameter_summary: Twenty-three bounded or stepped shape variables are combined with underbody, rear-body, and wheel choices. The discrete choices include two underbodies and three wheel treatments in addition to the three rear-body archetypes.

parameters.name: Wheels
parameters.range: open detailed, open smooth, or closed smooth

design_space.operating_conditions: The CFD condition is fixed at 30 m/s. Geometry-dependent vehicle length gives a reported Reynolds-number range of 8.366 × 10⁶ to 1.006 × 10⁷ rather than a separately sampled flow sweep.
design_space.sampling: Optimal Latin hypercube sampling with an enhanced stochastic evolutionary algorithm populates the mixed continuous/discrete design space; the current canonical collection lists 8,150 designs.
design_space.coverage: The source spans several production-car-like categories, but the active FluidsBench dev contract still contains only one prototype pressure case. Its leaderboard coverage therefore does not yet represent the full source design space.

benchmark.summary: The active dev contract is still a one-case prototype. It scores kinematic surface pressure p at every native VTK PointData location with area-weighted relative L2 as primary and equal-point relative L2 as secondary. It does not yet activate the reviewed 1,154-case test proposal, wall shear, volume fields, forces, or profiles.

visual.support: Current candidate: native surface pressure points

windsorml.name: WindsorML
windsorml.summary: High-fidelity wall-modelled LES data for 355 designed Windsor-body variants, with approximately 300 million cells per simulation and time-averaged boundary, volume, geometry, force, slice, and image products.

source.availability: 355 aggregate cases; 350 complete per-run field folders; approximately 8 TB
source.contents: STL and STEP geometry, native boundary and volume VTUs, force and geometry tables, flow images, eight split families, and native point dual-area sidecars for all 350 available boundary meshes. Runs 350–354 remain in aggregate split metadata but lack complete per-run geometry and image assets.

image.alt: Streamwise-velocity field around a Windsor body with its downstream wake.
image.caption: Streamwise-velocity slice from WindsorML run 1.

archetypes.name: Wheel-less squareback Windsor body
archetypes.description: The AutoCFD4 squareback reference is the common parent for all parameterized variants.

design_space.parameter_summary: The parametric CAD model changes front/rear proportions, fastback transition, taper, ground clearance, and underbody angle.
design_space.operating_conditions: All cases use the AutoCFD wind-tunnel-style setup at nominal 40 m/s, Reynolds number 2.9 × 10⁶, and 2.5° yaw; flow conditions are fixed.
design_space.sampling: A deterministic, extendable Halton sequence samples 355 points in the seven-dimensional geometry space; complete per-run fields are available for 350.
design_space.coverage: Eight source split families cover random, data-efficiency, and held-out regimes across the aggregate design list. The current FluidsBench contract still binds only one prototype case.

benchmark.summary: The candidate field definition uses cpavg and the cfxavg/cfyavg/cfzavg skin-friction vector on every native boundary point, plus velocityxavg/velocityyavg/velocityzavg and pressureavg on every native volume cell. Public dual-area sidecars and eight source split families now exist, but the FluidsBench contract still contains only one prototype case and has not bound the 350 complete field runs.

visual.support: Native boundary points and native volume cells
visual.metrics: Area-weighted surface errors; equal-cell volume errors; forces and profiles

hiliftaeroml.name: HiLiftAeroML
hiliftaeroml.summary: A 1,800-case wall-modelled LES dataset formed by 180 NASA CRM-HL geometry variants at ten angles of attack from 4° to 22°, with 300–500 million-cell solution-adapted meshes and native boundary, volume, geometry, force, and visual products.

source.availability: 1,800 cases; approximately 66.8 TB compressed on the Hub
source.contents: Compressed native boundary and volume VTUs, STL and STEP geometry, force/reference tables, surface renders and convergence plots, fourteen deterministic split families, data-quality masks, a native-point boundary dual-area sidecar for every case, and a provenance manifest for six corrected mean force/moment records.

image.alt: Wall-shear-stress rendering on the high-lift wing, slat, flap, and landing gear of a HiLiftAeroML case.
image.caption: Surface wall-shear rendering for geometry LHC001 at 4° angle of attack.

archetypes.name: NASA CRM-HL
archetypes.description: One semi-span high-lift aircraft parent with independently positioned inboard and outboard slats and flaps.

design_space.parameter_summary: Inboard and outboard slat and flap deflections are varied independently, together with multipliers applied to their reference gap schedules.
design_space.operating_conditions: Each geometry is simulated at ten angles of attack from 4° to 22° in 2° steps, at Mach 0.2 and chord Reynolds number 1.6 × 10⁶.
design_space.sampling: Latin hypercube sampling supplies 180 geometry variants, crossed with the ten-angle sweep for 1,800 CFD cases.
design_space.coverage: Fourteen published split families distinguish data efficiency, unseen geometry, single-angle tasks, angle extrapolation, high-deflection geometry, and stall behaviour. FluidsBench scoring bindings remain provisional.

benchmark.summary: The source now publishes all fourteen deterministic splits, native-point surface area sidecars, invalid-volume-row records, and six documented field-integrated mean force/moment corrections. FluidsBench has candidate surface, volume, force, Cp-cut, and velocity-profile metrics, but its case lists and exact scored array bindings remain provisional and are not active for submissions.

visual.support: Candidate native aircraft boundary and flow volume
visual.metrics: Candidate surface and volume errors, forces, Cp cuts, and near-wall profiles

airfrans.name: AirfRANS
airfrans.summary: A 1,000-case steady incompressible RANS dataset over NACA 4- and 5-digit airfoils, spanning Reynolds numbers from 2 to 6 million and angles of attack from −5° to 15°, with official standard, scarce-data, and extrapolation tasks.

source.availability: 1,000 simulations with downloadable preprocessed VTK and raw OpenFOAM releases
source.contents: Airfoil geometry and flow-node coordinates, inlet velocity, signed distance and normals, velocity U, kinematic pressure p, turbulent kinematic viscosity nut, surface quantities, and integrated aerodynamic coefficients. nut remains available in the source but is not a current FluidsBench target.

image.alt: AirfRANS field plots showing velocity, pressure, turbulent viscosity, signed distance, and airfoil surface quantities.
image.caption: Representative AirfRANS flow-domain and airfoil-surface fields.

archetypes.name: NACA 4-digit
archetypes.description: Single-camber-line family parameterized by maximum camber, its chordwise position, and thickness.

archetypes.name: NACA 5-digit
archetypes.description: Family parameterized by design-lift/camber terms, a standard-or-reflex choice, and thickness.

design_space.parameter_count: 3 or 4 airfoil-code parameters, depending on family
design_space.parameter_summary: Four-digit profiles use M, P, and XX; five-digit profiles use L, P, Q, and XX. The source applies explicit sampling restrictions to avoid unusable camber locations.
design_space.operating_conditions: The joint design space spans Reynolds numbers from 2 × 10⁶ to 6 × 10⁶ and angles of attack from −5° to 15°.
design_space.sampling: The source draws 1,000 joint airfoil-and-condition simulations from the stated geometry and flight-condition distributions; it is not a full Cartesian sweep of every shape.
design_space.coverage: The four official tasks provide a full-data reference, a scarce-data regime, Reynolds-number extrapolation, and angle-of-attack extrapolation. FluidsBench binds those official evaluation lists.

benchmark.status_label: Official case lists; scoring definition in preparation
benchmark.summary: FluidsBench binds the four official AirfRANS evaluation lists. The current scored flow fields are U and p—not nut—and the boundary task scores pressure plus wall shear derived by the fixed evaluator. Required diagnostics are Ux/U∞ and Uy/U∞ on 1,001-point extrados-normal lines at x/c = 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 0.95. Pressure-profile Cp is not a current leaderboard metric.

visual.inputs: Airfoil geometry + Reynolds number + angle of attack
visual.support: Every native 2D flow node and ordered airfoil node
visual.metrics: Equal-node domain errors; length-weighted boundary errors; forces and four velocity profiles

blendednet.name: BlendedNet
blendednet.summary: A public surface-aerodynamics dataset with 999 unique blended-wing-body geometries and 8,830 converged steady RANS cases across geometry and flight-condition variation, using 9–14 million volume cells per simulation.

source.availability: One 24.7 GB public archive containing 8,830 converged cases
source.contents: Nine geometric design parameters, flight conditions, point coordinates and normals, surface pressure and skin-friction coefficients, and integrated drag, lift, and pitching-moment coefficients. The public reference model uses Cp, Cfx, and Cfz; the raw VTK conversion also exposes cf_y when present.

image.alt: Illustrative top view of a blended-wing-body aircraft with surface-field contours and streamlines.
image.caption: Representative blended-wing-body configuration (FluidsBench illustration; not to scale).
image.credit: Based on the BlendedNet dataset description

archetypes.name: OpenVSP blended wing body
archetypes.description: One integrated lifting-body planform family; the airfoil-section coefficients are held fixed in this release.

design_space.parameter_summary: Six normalized chord/span dimensions and three sweep angles define the planform; airfoil cross-sections are not varied.
design_space.operating_conditions: Flight-condition sampling spans altitude 0–40 kft, Mach 0.05–0.5, Reynolds reference length 0.1–10 m, and angle of attack −10° to 20°.
design_space.sampling: Latin hypercube sampling produces 999 planforms and approximately nine flight conditions per geometry, with 8,830 simulations converging successfully.
design_space.coverage: The current candidate proposes a geometry-disjoint 870-case holdout, but that list is not a separately published official Dataverse evaluation set and is not active.

benchmark.summary: The candidate task is surface-only and uses cp plus cf_x/cf_y/cf_z on every native legacy-VTK surface point, with area-weighted relative L2 as the primary physical metric. The current 870-case geometry-holdout list is provisional; the public Dataverse release does not separately identify it as an official evaluation release, so this mapping is not active for submissions.

visual.metrics: Area-weighted and equal-point Cp/Cf errors plus integrated coefficients

rotor37.name: Rotor37
rotor37.summary: A PLAID-formatted collection of 1,200 three-dimensional RANS simulations of the NASA Rotor 37 compressor blade, with geometry and operating-condition inputs and distributed and integrated compressor outputs.

source.availability: 1,000 public training rows and 200 source-evaluation rows with hidden targets
source.contents: Blade-surface geometry and normals, rotational speed and pressure inputs, Density, Pressure, and Temperature fields, plus Massflow, Compression_ratio, and Efficiency scalars in the public training population. The source evaluation rows intentionally omit outputs.

image.alt: Rotor 37 blade surfaces showing a prediction, prediction variance, and relative error field.
image.caption: Representative Rotor37 field prediction, uncertainty, and error views.

archetypes.name: NASA Rotor 37
archetypes.description: Geometrical variants remain within the Rotor 37 compressor-blade family.

design_space.parameter_count: Mesh-native geometry; no published low-dimensional parameter vector
design_space.parameter_summary: PLAID exposes each blade surface directly as a non-parameterized mesh. Shape variation is therefore an input geometry, not a fixed list of scalar design variables.
design_space.operating_conditions: Two scalar inputs accompany the mesh: pressure P and rotational speed Ω. The public challenge description does not publish a compact range table for them.
design_space.sampling: The source contains 1,200 rows: 1,000 with public targets and 200 source-evaluation rows whose outputs are hidden.
design_space.coverage: Eight nested training-size tasks are published. Because the 200 source-test targets are hidden, FluidsBench still needs a separate public-ground-truth evaluation split before its design coverage can be scored openly.

benchmark.summary: The candidate scores Density, Pressure, and Temperature over every vertex of the native blade-surface CGNS zone, together with Massflow, Compression_ratio, and Efficiency. Because the source 200-case evaluation targets are hidden, FluidsBench must publish and approve a separate public-ground-truth evaluation split before submissions can open; the current eight case lists are prototypes.

visual.inputs: Blade surface + normals + Ω + inlet pressure
visual.metrics: Area-weighted surface-field errors and three scalar compressor quantities

vki-ls59.name: VKI-LS59
vki-ls59.summary: A PLAID-formatted collection of 839 two-dimensional compressible RANS simulations of the LS59 turbine cascade, spanning inlet incidence and outlet Mach number with geometry, signed-distance, field, curve, and scalar quantities.

source.availability: 671 public training rows and 168 source-evaluation rows with hidden targets
source.contents: Geometry, signed distance, inlet angle and outlet Mach inputs; two-dimensional ro, rou, rov, roe, nut, and mach fields; blade-curve M_iso; and Q, power, Pr, Tr, eth_is, and angle_out scalars in the training population. Source evaluation outputs are hidden.

image.alt: Four VKI-LS59 turbine-cascade Mach fields showing no shock, shock, strong shock, and lambda-shock regimes.
image.caption: Representative VKI-LS59 cascade regimes from no shock to lambda shock.

archetypes.name: VKI LS59 cascade blade
archetypes.description: Every case is a geometrical variation based on the same two-dimensional turbine-cascade reference.

design_space.parameter_count: Mesh-native geometry; no published low-dimensional parameter vector
design_space.parameter_summary: The geometry and its signed-distance field are provided directly. The public record does not define a fixed scalar parameterization for the blade variations.
design_space.operating_conditions: Two scalar inputs vary with geometry: inlet angle and outlet Mach number. The public record does not provide a compact range table for these inputs.
design_space.sampling: The source contains 839 rows: 671 with public targets and 168 source-evaluation rows whose outputs are hidden.
design_space.coverage: Eight nested training-size tasks are published. FluidsBench requires a public-ground-truth evaluation split because the source-test outputs are not released.

benchmark.summary: The candidate scores mach and nut on every native two-dimensional CGNS vertex, M_iso along every blade-curve vertex, and the six public scalar targets. Because the source 168-case evaluation targets are hidden, FluidsBench must publish and approve a separate public-ground-truth evaluation split; all eight current case lists are prototypes.

visual.inputs: Cascade geometry + signed distance + incidence + outlet Mach
visual.support: Candidate complete 2D domain and blade curve
visual.metrics: Equal-node domain errors; length-weighted M_iso; six scalar quantities
